title: AnalyticsView
description: Phase 17 W1 — Emitted by apps/viewer (and forwarded by apps/presenter / apps/join-web) when a viewer lands on a slide. Partition key in Kafka is workspace_id:viewer_id_key (joined at ingest). This is the foundational event for per-viewer, per-slide analytics (#169).

event_id.description: ULID assigned by the analytics-sdk at emission time.

ts_ms.description: Client-side timestamp (Date.now()). Server drift-corrected via session.heartbeat (W4).

slide_id.description: Stable scene-graph node ID from P02; survives reorder.

scene_node_id.description: Optional finer-grained node within the slide.

viewer_id_key.description: Privacy-mode aware salted hash; never the raw viewer_id. Partition key.

session_id.description: Assigned by services/sessionization in W4; empty until assigned.

experiment_id.description: Optional — non-empty only when the viewer is in an active A/B test.

referer_host.description: Bare host, never full URL. Empty for direct nav.

country_iso.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code from MaxMind GeoIP.

region_pinned.description: Bangladesh residency flag; 'bd' routes to the BD-only ClickHouse shard.

share_link_id.description: The P14 share-link token; used for per-link privacy-mode overrides.

experiment_concluded_at_ms.description: Optional — server-stamped once the event joins a concluded A/B test.

forward_compat.description: True when an unknown payload field was accepted by the schema validator.
